intro: Sembawang Anchor is an HDB BTO project in Sembawang, listed in the November 2026 BTO exercise with 1,310 flats, as recorded from HDB’s BTO portal in our project file. The same file note records it as an HDB Shorter Waiting Time project. The official confirmation covers the launch, the recorded unit count, and that designation; it does not confirm TOP or a key-collection date, and we will not invent a waiting period from the name. Tenure is left blank. Use your HDB documents for typologies and for any later appointment. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Sembawang Anchor renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Sembawang Anchor interior
sections.text:
A 1,310-flat estate will almost certainly include more than one typologies mix, which is why we will not guess a typical Anchor layout. When the official plan is issued, the carpentry that typically makes a new BTO liveable is a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall, with a built-in desk if a common bedroom will be a study. Maison specifies this as custom carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we can work in a wide room view or in closer shots of a kitchen run or a wardrobe. No official floor plan is on file.

Sembawang Brook and Sembawang Portico were launched earlier, in June 2026, and are not typologies or timetable references for Anchor, even though all three sit in the same town. A shorter official waiting-time designation still leaves the actual key date unconfirmed, so do not brief a contractor against a guessed year. We will not invent walking times to Sembawang town or to any MRT station.

After keys, inspect defects and apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance, not a promise. WhatsApp Maison with your unit type and approved plan when you have them. We are not affiliated with HDB.
